description: A function that keeps references to variables of its enclosing scope after that scope has returned.
Names in a closure are looked up when the function runs, so a loop variable shows its last value.
The object that holds a captured variable; `function.__closure__` lists them and `cell_contents` reads one.
A function that builds and returns a closure, creating a fresh scope (and fresh cells) per call.
Declares that assignments inside an inner function rebind a variable of the enclosing function.
